svg.title: Headings: what the number means
svg.desc: GaragePose.heading is an integer in degrees, 0 along +y, counter-clockwise positive, so 90 points to -x. A YAML node lists headings in 0..179; each also allows its reciprocal, which covers the same footprint.

g.text: Convention from GaragePose.msg's comment and LocomoteOrStrafe in garage_graph.cpp; yaw from Layout::GetGeometricPoseAtPose; range [-179, 180] from GaragePose.msg. YAML and GarageNode.headings use 0..179.

'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A heading is the direction a pose faces, in whole degrees: 0 along +y, counter-clockwise positive, so 90 faces -x (west) and -90 faces +x. It is an int16 in [-179, 180] in GaragePoseMsg; GeometricPoseMsg

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: carries the same angle as yaw in radians.
